adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the global `embed_category` site setting (deleted from `config/site_settings.yml`, `config/locales/server.en.yml`, and migration deletes it) and changes `TopicEmbed.import` to set `category: eh.try(:category_id)` where `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If no `EmbeddableHost` matches the URL host, `eh` is nil and `category` becomes nil, causing the topic to fall back to the default/Uncategorized. The diff provides no fallback to the previous behavior, so this is a real behavioral regression for any import path that reaches `TopicEmbed.import` with an unlisted host.
